new
material new Canvas --base-color 0.937 0.847 0.631 --no-slot
material new Paint --base-color 0.937 0.412 0.184 --no-slot
material new Wicker --base-color 0.447 0.255 0.075 --no-slot
material new Wall --base-color 0.937 0.847 0.631 --no-slot
material new Dark --base-color 0.224 0.165 0.110 --no-slot
add mesh uv-sphere --name Chute --segments 8 --rings 4 --radius 0.42 --location 0 0 0.62
select Chute
active Chute
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z < -0.01"
delete vert
select all
material assign Canvas
select face where "pos.x > 0 && pos.y >= 0 && pos.y < pos.x"
select face where "pos.x <= 0 && pos.y > 0 && -pos.x < pos.y" --extend
select face where "pos.x < 0 && pos.y <= 0 && pos.y > pos.x" --extend
select face where "pos.y < 0 && pos.x >= 0 && pos.x < -pos.y" --extend
material assign Paint
mode object
add mesh cube --name CrateB1 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 -0.100
scale 0.320 0.320 0.120
apply --scale
select CrateB1
material assign Wicker
add mesh cube --name CrateM2 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.000

apply --scale
select CrateM2
material assign Wall
add mesh cube --name CrateT3 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.100

select CrateT3
material assign Wicker
add mesh cube --name Line4 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.360

select Line4
material assign Dark
select all
